description.zh: DTS实例ID，您可以调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)接口查询实例ID。
description.en: The DTS instance ID. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the instance ID.

description.zh: ETL任务ID，您可以调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)接口查询任务ID。
description.en: The ETL task ID. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the task ID.

description.zh: 当前实例状态列表的页码，默认为1。
description.en: The page number of the instance status list. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，默认为20。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Settings this parameter for paging. Default value: 20.

description.zh: DTS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)接口查询阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the DTS instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query available regions.
